Fixed worker memory-retention issues: copied incoming usage batches before extending pending events and removed `BillingWorker._last_batch`, which retained completed event payloads. Added regression coverage for pending-event isolation. Worker tests passed (41), as did the full suite (118 passed, 7 skipped); a 5,000-batch reproduction stabilized at 2.1 MiB retained memory with zero pending events. Traced remaining `completed_batches` retention to intentional worker state containing full payload metadata.

Refactored duplicated invoice billing filters in `ledgerly/cli.py` into `_add_billing_filters(parser)`, preserving canonical `args.currency` with an explicit destination. Updated an obsolete command-test assertion; all 15 CLI and 22 command tests passed, and a USD invoice-list smoke test succeeded.

A separate GitHub Actions migration was requested but not started; follow the nine prescribed steps in order. Do not retry increasing Celery visibility timeout—it was ruled out. The stated SQLAlchemy 1.4-to-2.0 model migration has not yet been performed.

Created branch `gha/test-workflow`; GitHub Actions migration is at step 2 of nine and remains unfinished. Do not request review for changes to `ledgerly/storage/queries.py` without fresh EXPLAIN ANALYZE output for every modified query.
